name: Ish Bosheth
overview: Ish Bosheth, also called Esh-Baal, was made king over Israel by Abner, Saul's army captain, ruling for two years while the tribe of Judah followed David (2 Samuel 2:8-10). Abner initially supported Ish Bosheth but later grew resentful after Ish Bosheth accused him regarding Saul's concubine Rizpah, leading to Abner's desertion (2 Samuel 3:6-8). This tension highlights the fragile unity in Israel during the transition from Saul's dynasty to David's reign and sets the stage for David ultimately being restored to his rightful place as king.
